{{Top|leg}}
'''Botha''' was the written form of the [[Bothese|Bothan language]], originating on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was also adopted by the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]] for their own language, [[Dressellese]], after the Bothans discovered them.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
